info.description: RAG-over-PDF backend — health, ingest and query. Import into Postman (or Bruno / Insomnia / Hoppscotch). {{base_url}} defaults to the app's port (8791). Put your PDF in data/in, then run in order: Ingest, then the Query requests. Each /query response is also written to data/out and is exactly what you copy into submission/.

request.description: Index the first *.pdf in data/in/. Pass "reset": true to rebuild, or "filename" to pick a specific PDF.
Just a question and its level. The system assigns the id and conversation for you. The response is written to data/out.
Send your level-2 questions in order. They automatically share one conversation, so your system can use the earlier turns.
